name: high-selectivity-scan
description: Exercise point, narrow range and rare dimension predicates against persisted events

queries.name: point-count
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE event_id = 1

queries.name: short-range-sum
queries.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM events WHERE event_id BETWEEN 10 AND 50

queries.name: selective-region-count
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE region = 'EU' AND event_id BETWEEN 1 AND 100

queries.name: point-range-topk
queries.sql: SELECT event_id, amount FROM events WHERE event_id BETWEEN 50 AND 80 ORDER BY event_id DESC LIMIT 10
